summary: The customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based measurement in the tablet press feed frame can monitor API concentration changes in a powder blend.

facts_stated.text: They manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks are too slow because results arrive after the material has moved through the press.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press.

facts_stated.text: They want to assess a fiber-based measurement in the feed frame to follow API concentration changes.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes.

facts_stated.text: The first pilot will compare measurement options before committing to production equipment.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before we commit to production equipment.

heterogeneous.enquiry_quote: powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients

customer_premises.claim: A fiber-based measurement in the feed frame can follow API concentration changes.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes
